principles: id-recency carries zero material/scope information: a second run_start changes only the reviewRunId, not what was reviewed.
The live-snapshot freshness + scope checks are the staleness authorities; the id check only false-rejects substantively-current evidence.
Relax must be KIND-AWARE: passes become valid when material+scope fresh, but OPEN findings keep surfacing so a newer pass cannot hide an unresolved finding.
Never let an empty-set (no-signal) storyFilesHash enable the drift advisory.
drivers: The quorum-blocking false-reject (a material-fresh pass stranded by a concurrent run_start forced a fresh REVIEW round in B-70e4).
Soundness of the REVIEW gate that feeds the 3x2 escalation quorum.
Preserving flow-stability's pass-supersession + open-finding-surfacing + resolved-finding-supersession semantics.

options.name: Relax id-recency kind-aware + EMPTY guard (+ doc reconcile)
pros: Sound: freshness+scope still reject genuine drift
EMPTY guard closes the no-signal hole for all callers
cons: Touches a shared freshness function (broader blast radius — mitigated by test:all)
Leaves the run_start/pass_set lock window (benign once the race no longer false-rejects)

options.name: keep-strict (no change)
cons: Preserves the quorum-blocking false-reject for a check that adds no soundness

options.name: unify-lock-A only
cons: Does NOT fix the race: a legitimate later run_start still invalidates an earlier fresh pass under strict id-recency. Rejected as a standalone fix.

options.name: blanket relax (both kinds) without the EMPTY guard
cons: Breaks flow-stability's open-finding supersession (a newer pass could hide an unresolved finding); and is unsound under empty-set storyFilesHash drift. Rejected — caught by the spike + the adversarial review.

chosen: Relax id-recency kind-aware + EMPTY guard (+ doc reconcile)
rationale: Locked by an adversarial design workflow (relax + mandatory EMPTY guard; lock-unification deferred) and refined by a red->spike->story spike that caught the open-finding regression of a blanket relax, hence the kind-aware validate-side relax. Verified red->green plus flow-stability green plus test:all 0 genuine FAIL.

preMortem.trigger: A review run captured with an empty story diff (HEAD==main) persists storyFilesHash=sha256(''); under whole-tree drift the live diff is also empty
preMortem.consequence: The drift advisory accepts a stale-material run that vouches for nothing (worst on non-scope-protected stories)
preMortem.mitigation: Add the EMPTY_STORY_FILES_HASH guard to checkEvidenceFreshnessForGit so empty on either side falls through to strict materialHash; covered by the spike GUARD case

preMortem.scenario: Open finding hidden by a newer pass
preMortem.trigger: A blanket relax removes stale_run for findings too; a reviewer files an open finding on run-1 then a pass on run-2
preMortem.consequence: The newer pass hides the unresolved finding and the gate wrongly passes
preMortem.mitigation: Kind-aware relax: keep stale_run for findings; flow-stability case 2 asserts the open finding still blocks

preMortem.trigger: A non-latest run was captured against an older scope contract/diff and the live scope changed
preMortem.consequence: Accepting it would miss a scope change
preMortem.mitigation: compareScopeBinding (691-699/837-857) still re-digests the live contract+diff and rejects scope drift; relax only removes id-recency, not the scope check

preMortem.trigger: run-1's materialHash differs from live and storyFilesHash mismatches (real story-owned change)
preMortem.mitigation: checkEvidenceFreshnessForGit still hard-rejects on materialHash mismatch + storyFilesHash mismatch; the spike GUARD case asserts a material-drifted run still rejects
